en: This is a vintage postcard. The front features a winter scene of Sundsvall, with snow-covered streets and houses, looking toward Norra Stadsberget, a forested hill north of the city. On the back, there is handwritten Swedish text, a Swedish 5 öre stamp, and space for correspondence and an address. The printing includes multiple languages, notably French and Swedish, and details of the publisher J. Sunessons Bokhandel.
